items.q: so in order to join the union I played with Lucky Millinder, to, you know, make a living and put in my time.

ctx.x: Well, in order to earn a living, you know, very often, you know, there wasn't enough work on 52nd Street to keep me working all the time, and I was also putting in my time to join the musician's union. You were required to be in that area for a six month period. And I hadn't joined the union, so in order to join the union I played with Lucky Millinder, to, you know, make a living and put in my time.
